t.E914.agn: In 2015 EFSA stated that the substance is not genotoxic and that no accumulation was seen in 90-day studies; owing to a lack of long-term data it did not set an ADI. It calculated a margin of safety of 4,400 at the highest estimated intake and concluded that there is no safety concern at the authorised uses.
t.E914.found.0: Surface of citrus fruits, melons, papayas, mangoes, avocados and pineapples
t.E914.prod: A polymer obtained by mild oxidation of polyethylene with air.
t.E914.regx.0: Re-evaluated; no ADI set, no safety concern at the authorised uses.
t.E914.summary: A synthetic wax. Used in coating the peel of citrus and some other fruits.
t.E914.what: A synthetic wax obtained by oxidising polyethylene; used on the surface of fruit.
